The mixed-arm disclosure needs no extra sentence: assigned_values cover whichever seat held each level.

Demo debrief explains automated teammates and assigned pressure ratings. Data-use choice wording is added under D09 (INV-0907).

Approved for live pilot fielding (2026-10-07, BA-99 audit remediation): body identical to the bound reference version; approved successor minted so the restored approved-only live gate binds only approved material.
